item.title: Asbestos sheeting loose and debris on floor, 10th September
item.description:
This has been an ongoing issues for a number of months! The old metro cabs hut asbestos sheeting has become loose and broken up. This debris has scattered on the floor with some larger sheeting being there as well. I have personally seen people brushing past this on way to/from station. I am not sure asbestos fibres are something people would like on their clothes. This issues needs to be looked at by the council, SouthEastern and/or national rail as this is an unsafe condition to have on such a public walkway from Sidcup station.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Greenwood Close, Blackfen, Greater London
